components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one red action on a viewport.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:50px; padding:0 24px; border-radius:6px; background:#d4141d; color:#fff; font:600 16px/1 Alexandria, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#bf1017; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ff3b44; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:50px; padding:0 24px; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#f4f4f2; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24); font:600 16px/1 Alexandria, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#fff; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ff3b44; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Patch
components.description: Stitched division mark inside a tile.
components.css: .ds-patch { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; background:#1b1b1e; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #1b1b1e, inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color:#f4f4f2; font:600 12.5px/1.4 Alexandria, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.02em; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-patch-red { background:#d4141d; border-color:#9e0f16; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #d4141d, inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.55); color:#fff; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Jacket panel with outer border, stitched inner line and optional red seam.
components.html:
Motorcycles

Hero and SYM agents in Jordan.

Two-wheelers for riders and fleets, with parts and service behind them.
components.css: .ds-panel { position:relative; padding:26px; border-radius:6px; background:#131315; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#f4f4f2; font:400 15px/1.6 Alexandria, sans-serif; } .ds-panel::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:6px; border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.13); border-radius:4px; pointer-events:none; } .ds-seam { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 #ed1c26; } .ds-panel h3 { margin:12px 0 8px; font:800 24px/1.08 Alexandria, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; color:rgba(244,244,242,0.72); } .ds-panel .ds-patch { display:inline-flex; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; background:#1b1b1e; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #1b1b1e, inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.18); font:600 12.5px/1.4 Alexandria, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, field below, red focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font:600 14px/1.4 Alexandria, sans-serif; color:#f4f4f2; } .ds-field input { padding:14px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24); background:#131315; color:#f4f4f2; font:400 15px/1.4 Alexandria, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:rgba(244,244,242,0.5); } .ds-field input:focus { outline:2px solid #ff3b44; outline-offset:1px; border-color:#ed1c26; }

components.name: Tape Rule
components.css: .ds-tape { height:10px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 0 28px, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 28px 40px); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, #000 30%, #000 70%, transparent 100%); mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, #000 30%, #000 70%, transparent 100%); opacity:0.55; }

narrative.overview: The site is built the way a delivery captain's jacket is built: colour-blocked panels joined by stitched seams, reflective tape at the breaks, and patches that say who you ride for. The ground is off-black like the Diken suit; the only colour Diken itself wears is the brand red. Every partner appears in its own colour, on its own panel, as a peer standing beside Diken rather than a client standing behind it.
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme, page-wide, no section inverts to light.
Red leads: it carries every primary action, every emphasis word, every seam.
Panels have a 1px outer border and a 1px dashed inner border, the stitch.
Partner colours appear only on partner panels.
Alexandria for everything, English and Arabic.

rules.name: The Red Under White Rule
rules.body: Text on red uses Red Fill (#d4141d), not Brand Red. Brand Red is for red-on-dark only.

rules.name: The Quoted Colour Rule
rules.body: A partner's colour appears only inside that partner's panel or uniform. It never colours Diken's own controls, headings or rules.

rules.name: The Sentence Rule
rules.body: Headings are sentences and end with a period. No labels above headings.

rules.name: The No Drop Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. Hover lifts a panel by 3px and raises its tone one step.

dos: Do set every figure in tabular lining numerals.
Do keep one dark theme across every page and section.
Do use Red Fill (#d4141d) under white text and Brand Red (#ed1c26) on dark.
Do give every panel both borders: 1px solid outside, 1px dashed inside at 6px.
Do end headings with a period and write them as sentences.
Do honour reduced motion: reveals and the hero stagger collapse to their final state.
donts: Don't put a label, kicker or eyebrow above a heading; patches live inside tiles.
Don't use a partner's colour outside that partner's panel.
Don't add drop shadows, gradient text or glass on content panels.
Don't use the em dash or en dash anywhere on the site; the build refuses them.
